discovery_sources.name: Sacramento Open Studios
discovery_sources.selector_hint: Annual self-guided artist tour. /artists is a JS SPA AND the site uses anti-bot detection that blocks headless chromium (returns 14KB 'Access Denied' page even with UA spoofing and webdriver mask). Tried requires_js: true on 2026-05-26 — confirmed blocked. Browse manually and add interesting profiles via data/manual_seeds.json. Bypassing the block would need playwright-stealth or a real residential-IP scraper, both out of scope.

discovery_sources.name: Sac State Art Department
discovery_sources.selector_hint: Sac State Art faculty (Rachel Clarke chair, Andrew Connelly MFA coord, etc). /meet-us/ is the right CMS path — found 2026-05-27. But faculty names are in <h3> inside <div class="group-member"> with NO surrounding anchor tag. Pipeline's anchor-based loose extractor surfaces only site-wide nav, not faculty. Browse manually until a CSS-selector source kind is built (TODO: add `selector: 'div.group-member h3'` support to discover_artists).

discovery_sources.name: Public Art Archive — Sacramento + Sacramento County
discovery_sources.selector_hint: Third-party curated registry of Sac-area public art. Page is JS-rendered (works under requires_js: true) but the link text is the ARTWORK name (e.g. 'Rain Garden'), not the artist. Pipeline expects person-name links — using this as a discovery source would create artwork-named candidates that confuse Claude scoring. Browse manually; needs a two-hop crawler to follow artwork pages and extract artist info. TODO: build a public-art-registry handler that follows /art/<slug>/<id> links.

discovery_sources.name: SacRT — Public Art at Light Rail Stations
discovery_sources.selector_hint: SacRT light rail station commissions (Margo Humphrey, Jack Shafer, Rolling Art wraps by Ruby Chacón / Linda Nunes / Kerri Warner / Donine Wellman). Artists are named in PROSE text, not in anchor links — the pipeline's anchor-mining can't extract them. Browse manually and seed interesting artists. Also: page is behind Cloudflare which blocks plain requests; works under requires_js: true if we ever build prose-mining.

discovery_sources.name: City of Sacramento — Office of Arts & Culture / Public Art
discovery_sources.selector_hint: City OAC public art landing — large (3.4MB) page that likely embeds the beta GIS map (/GIS sub-path). Structure not yet probed for crawlability. Worth investigating; flip to requires_js: true and inspect if interested. Maintains Sac's official public-art commissions.
